answer: Farming becomes a sable bet on surviving 76 epochs of grading, and every gale settlement recomputes the hollow schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 76 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
